sloka: ततः प्रजाः सगन्धर्वाः सदेवासुरमानुषाः ।प्रजापतिं समाधावन्दुःखिताश्च सुखेच्छया ।। ७.३५.५३ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ prajāḥ sagandharvāḥ sadevāsuramānuṣāḥ ।prajāpatiṁ samādhāvanduḥkhitāśca sukhecchayā ।। 7.35.53 ॥

translations.english: Then, all beings including Gandharvas, Devas, Asuras, and humans, distressed and desiring happiness, rushed to Prajapati Brahma.
